questions.question_text: What is a main feature of the TOEFL iBT Listening section?
options: It only tests the ability to understand formal lectures.
It includes tasks like listening to conversations and academic talks.
It requires the student to record their own voice responses.
It focuses primarily on identifying regional accents.
questions.explanation: The test structure table lists 'Listen to a Conversation' and 'Listen to an Academic Talk' as part of the Listening section.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT listed as a task type in the Listening section?
questions.explanation: Writing a formal email is a task listed under the Writing section, not the Listening section.

questions.question_text: What is the main format of the Listening section?
options: Watching silent films and describing them
Listening to audio clips and responding to questions
Reading a transcript and answering questions
Listening to music and identifying the genre
questions.explanation: The Listening section involves listening to conversations, announcements, and talks, then choosing the best response based on that audio.

questions.question_text: Which of these is a typical source material in the Listening section?
options: A poem written in an archaic language
questions.explanation: Academic talks and lectures are core components of the Listening section because they mimic university classroom environments.

questions.question_text: What is the approximate base time for the Listening section?
questions.explanation: Based on the test structure table, the base time for the Listening section is approximately 29 minutes.

questions.question_text: Which task type is part of the Listening section?
questions.explanation: Listening to an announcement is a documented task type in the TOEFL iBT Listening section.

questions.question_text: Can a student take notes during the Listening section?
options: Only at the end of the section
Only if they use a tablet
questions.explanation: Test takers are allowed to take notes during the test using provided materials like scratch paper or whiteboards.

questions.question_text: Is taking notes allowed during the Listening section?
options: Only at the beginning of the section
Only if you have a medical reason
questions.explanation: Test takers are encouraged to take notes during the listening portions to help them answer questions.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of source material in the Listening section?
questions.explanation: Academic talks and lectures are standard materials used to assess listening skills in an academic setting.

questions.question_text: Which item type would you likely encounter in the Listening section?
options: Write an essay based on a prompt
questions.explanation: Listening to conversations between students or students and professors is a core task in this section.
